reviews.text: I have been boarding my dog with Eric for about a year and it has been a great experience.  I fully trust that my dog will be cared for and protected while I am away, and everything is professionally run.  Highly recommended.
I had my 3 dogs let out 3x/day. They were happy, well taken care of, and I received many pictures. He also brought our mail in and cleaned the dog's dishes!
We have an older dog and we were very happy to find Eric to watch him when we are gone. We feel so much better taking trips when we know he is well taken care of.

Eric and the team at Metropup are amazing at caring for our big puppies when we are away from home. Scheduling is convenient and Eric is great at working with us in the event of unplanned or emergency travel. Highly recommend if you are looking for professional and consistent services.
Very pleased with the service. I am already booking them again.

Absolutely premier care and service. A+ communication and personalized care for my fur babies. They are very professional and offer a variety of services depending on your needs. I have done the overnight care during trips when I am out-of-town and with plenty of communication and photos, I am always at ease knowing our pets are very well cared for. Book with Metro Pup SA if you are looking for a reliable, professional, caring pet sitter.

My wife and I live and travel between San Antonio and Nicaragua. We have to travel a lot for business and always worry about who we are leaving the fur kids with.

We have had great help previously however, we used to have to drive really far to board the kids at a location out of town. We prefer to keep them at home since a) they are less stressed and b) they aren't really socialized.

Enter Metro Pup.

We are so happy and even have planned last minute get aways that Eric and his team were able to arrange for. We know the kids are getting the best care and, Eric is a great person who we get along with so well.

Professional. Reliable. Caring.

Thanks guys!

I used MetroPupSA over the Christmas holiday to watch my three large dogs in my home and  was extremely impressed with the service. I am very protective of my dogs and anxious about leaving them when I travel but MetroPup business model sets you up for success with the client profile, app, and fabulous communication during the entire time. I was able to really enjoy my vacation knowing my dogs were being attended to - getting alerts and updates with photos, it was wonderful. If you are someone that has a hard time leaving your pets when you travel this service is for you.

The pet sitters from Metro Pup SA always do an outstanding job caring for my cat.  The messages and photos left in the portal are wonderful and informative.  I feel completely comfortable having them care for my pet and coming in my home.  I know Tobi is in the best of hands while I am away.

I am so happy with Eric and his Team at Metro Pup.   They were truly amazing with the care, love and attention that my kitty received.  Love the daily pictures and updates and just the way my pet was treated and cared for!  Will definitely use them again and highly recommend their services.

Can’t recommend team Metro Pup enough! We’ve been so happy with our experience. Eric and team are so thoughtful, caring, and detail oriented. Our pup gets the best care, cuddles, and exercise during the day while we’re working. The team also provides thorough updates on each visit. And we had wonderful experience with overnight stays. So thankful we found Metro Pup shortly after we moved to the area! The doggie smiles say it all!
Eric takes such good care of our pups. It’s nice knowing they are in great hands while we are away!
Best Pet Sitting Service that comes to your home!

Love this service! We know our fur babies are well taken care of when we travel. I love the app and getting updates on how each visit goes. Eric did our first trip and brought in Sarah to help on our second trip. Both are AMAZING. We will continue to use Metro Pup whenever we travel or need dog sitting/walking.

We left mochi under the care of Eric, and mochi was the happiest during her stay! She was so well taken care of, she played so much with Lola, slept on the couch just like at home, was taken on walks and got a proper bath.

Strongly recommend using this service we had great updates every day with multiple pictures. Very quick to respond to our messages as well I can't thank Eric enough! 10/10 would use this doggy service again and highly recommend!

Thank you Eric you are the best <3
